config.AC_BAR_tip: Choose the token bar Combat Assistant uses for armor class.
config.ALWAYS_RUN_MACRO: Runs even when the target is not affected.
config.APPLY_CONDITION_MARKER_tip: Apply configured token markers after confirmed failed saving throws. OFF retains narrative-only results.
config.APPLY_ROLL20_ICON_DAMAGE_COLOR_tip: Recolor Roll20-style damage icons using Combat Assistant damage-type colors.
config.AREA_HIT_EFFECT_NAME_tip: Built-in base effect or exact Custom FX name used when damage is applied through a saving throw. Leave empty to disable.
config.AREA_MARKER_FREE_MOVEMENT_tip: ON lets area markers move freely; OFF snaps them to the Roll20 grid.
config.AREA_RADIUS_DEBUG_DRAW_tip: Draw temporary GM-only reference circles while resolving supported radius area markers.
config.BLOCK_PLAYER_NO_RESOURCES_tip: Hide player Roll, DMG, ATK, Heal, Cast, and Send buttons when the action or spell has a verified resource cost and insufficient uses or spell slots. GM controls and no-cost actions are unaffected.
config.CA_ROLLS_INITIATIVE_tip: ON lets Combat Assistant roll 2024 initiative from sheet data; OFF keeps native Roll20 initiative.
config.CHAT_BACKGROUND_IMAGE_URL_tip: Set the background image used by Combat Assistant cards.
config.CHAT_DEBUG_ATTACKS_tip: Temporarily print full attack diagnostics in chat after opening Combat.
config.CHAT_DEBUG_SPELLS_tip: Temporarily print full spell diagnostics in chat after opening Spells.
config.CHAT_PROBE_tip: Whisper compact Roll20 chat-message diagnostics to the GM for parser testing.
config.CHAT_TRACKING_tip: Read Roll20 attack, damage, healing, and related combat rolls.
config.COMBAT_VISUAL_EFFECTS_tip: Show automatic Roll20 FX when Combat Assistant applies damage, healing, temporary HP, projectile attacks, or area effects.
config.CONCENTRATION_MARKER_tip: Roll20 token marker name/tag used while a token is concentrating. Default: stopwatch.
config.CONCENTRATION_TOOLTIP_GM_ONLY_tip: Show Combat Assistant concentration token tooltips only to the GM.
config.CONCENTRATION_TRACKING_tip: Track concentration spells, area markers, persistent actions, targets, and concentration saves.
config.CONC_TURN_TRACKER_tip: Decrease finite concentration duration when the caster reaches its turn and end it automatically at 0.
config.CONDITION_MARKER_tip_end: . Must exist in the campaign to render.
config.CONSUME_ACTION_RESOURCES_tip: Automatically consume one matching non-spell resource when a confirmed action with the same normalized name is used.
config.CONSUME_SPELL_SLOTS_tip: Automatically consume the confirmed spell cost, preferring an exact linked Beacon spell Resource before a generic spell slot.
config.DAMAGE_ROUND_UP_tip: Round halved damage up instead of down.
config.DEBUG_tip: Temporary API-console debug logging. Resets to OFF whenever the sandbox restarts.
config.DIRECT_HIT_EFFECT_NAME_tip: Built-in base effect or exact Custom FX name used when damage is applied without a saving throw. Leave empty to disable.
config.EFFECT_TRACKER_tip: Track temporary save-based conditions and show due repeat-save controls on the affected token Turn Card.
config.FORCE_TURN_ORDER_POSITION_tip: Keep new Turn Order entries in initiative order while preserving the active turn once combat has started.
config.GET_TOKEN_IMAGE_URL_tip: Select exactly one token and return its current live token image URL.
config.HANDLE_ACTIONS_tip: Show Dash, Special, C. Sheet, Combat, and Spells controls on Turn Cards.
config.HIDE_COMBAT_LOG_tip: Whisper Combat Logs to the GM instead of publishing them. Healing amounts are controlled separately by Hide Damage Details.
config.HIDE_DAMAGE_DETAILS_tip: Hide public damage details and healing amounts in Combat Logs, including GM whispers. This also suppresses public resistance-detail text.
config.HIDE_RESISTANCE_DETAILS_tip: Keep final damage amount and type visible, but hide resistance, immunity, and vulnerability explanations in public Combat Logs.
config.HP_BAR_tip: Choose the token bar Combat Assistant uses for hit points.
config.LANGUAGE_tip: Select the language used for Combat Assistant menus and messages.
config.MOVEMENT_CONSUMED_BLOCKER_tip: Lock the current player-controlled token after all available movement is spent. Dash restores movement when available.
config.NPC_RESOURCE_MANAGEMENT_tip: Give eligible unlinked NPC tokens independent resource pools stored in Token GM Notes.
config.ONLY_DAMAGE_CARD_tip: Show the GM a direct Hit card for standalone Damage rolls with no proven attack, save, or target range.
config.PLAYER_ACTION_RANGE_CHECK_tip: Check caster-to-target range before generated player spell controls apply healing or damage.
config.PLAYER_AREA_MARKER_KEEP_UNTIL_ROLLED_tip: Keep an area marker visible until every affected saving throw and damage resolution is complete.
config.PLAYER_ATTACK_BUTTON_tip: Whisper supported attack controls to the controlling player so they can select a target and resolve the attack.
config.PLAYER_HEALING_BUTTON_tip: Whisper supported healing controls to the controlling player so they can select a target and apply healing.
config.PLAYER_MANUAL_ROLL_tip: Ask player-controlled tokens to make their own supported saving throws and initiative rolls when Roll20 exposes a usable native button.
config.PLAYER_MARKER_OPACITY_tip: Set the opacity percentage for player area-marker tokens.
config.PLAYER_MARKER_RADIUS_URL_tip: Roll20 uploaded image URL used for radius, sphere, cylinder, or emanation area markers.
config.PLAYER_MARKER_SQUARE_URL_tip: Roll20 uploaded image URL used for square, cube, cone, or line area markers.
config.PLAYER_PUBLIC_RESOURCE_USAGE_tip: Publish player Resource Update cards instead of whispering them privately.
config.PLAYER_SPELL_MACRO_BUTTONS_tip: Show interactive spell macro buttons to the GM and players who control the caster. When OFF, show them only to the GM.
config.PLAYER_TOKEN_AREA_MARK_tip: Allow generated player area-spell controls to place a movable area marker and resolve tokens inside it.
config.PROJECTILE_EFFECT_NAME_tip: Built-in or Custom FX name used from attacker to target for ranged projectile attacks. Leave empty to disable.
config.PUBLIC_PRESENTATION_CARD_tip: ON shows the startup presentation card publicly. OFF whispers it only to the GM.
config.PUBLIC_ROUND_COUNTER_tip: Also publish the Round Counter card to players. Round Counter must be ON.
config.PUBLIC_TURN_MARKER_tip: OFF keeps the turn marker on the GM layer; ON puts it on the map layer and brings it forward.
config.REMOVE_NPC_DEAD_TOKENS_tip: Automatically remove unlinked NPC turns at 0 HP; OFF leaves a red manual Remove control.
config.REQUIRE_AC_FOR_ATTACK_tip: Require a valid AC value before resolving attack-roll damage. OFF allows attack damage to continue when the configured AC bar is empty.
config.REVEAL_DAMAGE_SOURCE_tip: Show who caused damage or healing and which attack, spell, or ability caused it.
config.REVEAL_TOKEN_NAMES_IN_LOG_tip: Show token names in Combat Logs. OFF uses generic Target, Attacker, Caster, or Healer labels.
config.ROUND_COUNTER_tip: Enable the Round Counter card and current-combat token summary.
config.SHEET_2014_CA_ROLLS_tip: OFF keeps native 2014 saving throws and initiative; ON lets Combat Assistant perform those supported rolls.
config.SHOW_EFFECTS_LIST_tip: Show sheet effect toggles at the top of the Combat menu.
config.SHOW_NPC_RESOURCES_tip: Show limited resources and spell slots for non-player-controlled tokens on the GM Turn Card.
config.SHOW_PLAYER_RESOURCES_tip: Show player-controlled token resources and spell slots directly on its Turn Card.
config.SHOW_PREPARED_SPELLS_ONLY_2024_tip: Show only 2024 spells marked Prepared or Always Prepared, including cantrips only when Roll20 marks them prepared.
config.TEMP_HP_BAR_tip: Choose the token bar used for temporary HP, or 0 to disable token-bar Temp HP.
config.TURN_AUTO_FOCUS_tip: Ping and focus eligible users on the current-turn token.
config.TURN_FOCUS_FOR_EVERYONE_tip: ON focuses everyone; OFF focuses only GMs and controllers of the current token or character.
config.TURN_MARKER_FOLLOW_tip: Keep the Turn Marker centered and scaled when the current token moves or resizes.
config.TURN_MARKER_IMAGE_URL_tip: Roll20 uploaded image used for the turn marker token.
config.TURN_MARKER_IMG_SIZE_tip: Percentage added to current token width and height for the Turn Marker. Default 20.
config.TURN_MARKER_ROTATION_SPEED_tip: Milliseconds between Turn Marker rotation updates. Default 100 ms.
config.TURN_MARKER_ROTATION_STEPS_tip: Degrees applied on every Turn Marker rotation update. Default 1.
config.TURN_MARKER_ROTATION_tip: Rotate the Turn Marker while combat is active.
config.TURN_MARKER_tip: Spawn a marker token on the current-turn token.
config.TURN_MOVEMENT_BLOCKER_tip: Lock player-controlled initiative tokens until their turn. Automatically unlock when their turn begins or they leave initiative.
config.TURN_MOVEMENT_TRACKER_tip: Track movement spent by the current-turn token and warn when it exceeds available speed.
config.TURN_TRACKER_tip: Track combat rounds and current turns from the Roll20 Turn Order.
config.USE_ROLL20_DAMAGE_ICON_tip: Use Roll20-style SVG damage icons instead of the default Combat Assistant icons.
config.USE_SHEET_DAMAGE_TRAITS_tip: Read sheet damage resistances, immunities, and vulnerabilities when applying damage.
config.USE_SPELL_MACROS_tip: Run configured Apply and End macros for matching spells. Turning this OFF preserves saved macros.
config.USE_SPELL_TEMPLATES_tip: Use matching spell templates for area markers. When OFF, use the default marker image.
